source: Scryfall API search unique=prints include_extras/include_variations; pulled 2026-09-22 UTC
filters: game=magic (set membership); paper in games; digital=false; lang=en. HOC dw excluded.

reconciliation.Cardmarket_Extras_partition: Product type rule established: Cardmarket Extras rows prefixed Art Series are art-card collectibles (including standard/gold-stamped V.1/V.2 variants as separately listed), while entries naming game cards are alternate product versions resolving to HOB collector identities+treatments and never new playable identities. Art Series cross-reference is by exact artwork/card name and checklist number when known. Full Cardmarket row/product-ID join is not verified because Cardmarket blocks structured page access (HTTP 403); no IDs are guessed.
reconciliation.THOB: TCGplayer product records and retailer catalogs identify 14 double-sided collector-number pairings. Cardmarket’s visible 12 product names do not expose all pair-level distinctions; #2//13 and #8//6 are independently present in TCGplayer. Explicit catalog order is retained, including #15//14. Product finish counts: 9 token/token pairings both nonfoil and traditional foil, 2 token/token pairings foil-only, 3 helper-containing pairings nonfoil-only; total 23 product/finish rows. Scryfall face scope remains 28 rows; face finish presence must not be conflated with pairing-product finish. All supported product-pair evidence and finish notes are stored in thob_physical_products.csv.
reconciliation.Art_Series: Wizards official gallery lists 54 numbered core art cards with standard and gold-stamped copies and 12 separate scene-box art cards. The Art Series object is separate from the matching playable HOB card even when artwork/name matches. Cardmarket Extras labels these as Art Series V.1/V.2 by Cardmarket version; exact V.1/V.2-to-unstamped/gold-stamped correspondence has not been verified and remains unassigned.

cardmarket_source: https://www.cardmarket.com/en/Magic/Spoilers/The-Hobbit-Extras (accessed 2026-09-22); listing identifies XHOB extras; scraped names must be reconciled by V.1/V.2 (Art Series) versus named HOB alternate versions.
finish_dimension: finish stores nonfoil/foil per Scryfall; finish_detail distinguishes surge foil when promo_types explicitly marks surgefoil; foil otherwise is traditional/unspecified. Actual finish-specific availability follows Scryfall record, constrained by Wizards collation: nonfoil Play token and traditional foil Collector token; no surge foil.
